verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a code-first SDK for TypeScript, Python and Go, so its core capabilities are all programmatic: act, extract, observe, agent, browser launch/attach, contexts and caching. Those same primitives are also exposed to agents over MCP and framework integrations, so there is no separate product UI holding back features. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), and evidence that the session dashboard's recording/replay features are reachable via API.
